title: The integration-PR builder copies each lane's Retire-run and Drops-lines lines into the batch body
why: CI reads only the integration PR's body, and a body edit does not re-run CI, so a lane's lines that stay on its own PR are never read.
note: Stacked on #1712 (silent-undo-ci-body). Filed from the coordinator, 19:26 CST Nov 7.
